description: Implementation of POSIX pthread barrier functions for Zephyr RTOS, including barrier initialization, wait, destroy, and attribute management.

methods.name: get_posix_barrier
methods.description: Retrieves the internal posix_barrier structure associated with a pthread_barrier_t handle.

methods.name: pthread_barrier_wait
methods.description: Blocks until all threads have called this barrier, then releases them.

methods.name: pthread_barrier_init
methods.description: Initializes a barrier object with a specified count.

methods.name: pthread_barrier_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a barrier object, freeing associated resources.

methods.name: pthread_barrierattr_setpshared
methods.description: Sets the process-shared attribute of a barrier.

methods.name: pthread_barrierattr_getpshared
methods.description: Gets the process-shared attribute of a barrier.
